# Longstrider (`spells:longstrider`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a pinch of dirt) | **Duration:** 1 hour | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
